exercises.instructionUz: Bu odamlar haqida namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: Who was John F. Kennedy?
  S2: He was an American president. When was he born?
  S3: He was born in 1917. When did he die?
  S4: He died in 1963.

UCHTA SAVOL QOLIPI:

  1) WHO WAS + ism?          → Kim edi?
     Javob: He/She WAS + kasb.

  2) WHEN WAS he/she BORN?   → Qachon tug'ilgan?
     Javob: He/She WAS BORN IN + yil.

  3) WHEN DID he/she DIE?    → Qachon vafot etgan?
     Javob: He/She DIED IN + yil.

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — 'BE BORN':
  Ingliz tilida 'tug'ilmoq' — MAJHUL nisbatda:
     I WAS BORN in 2010.        ✓
     I BORN in 2010.            ✗ XATO
     I WAS BORNED in 2010.      ✗ XATO
  So'zma-so'z: 'tug'ilgan bo'ldim'.

DIQQAT — 'DIE' esa ODDIY fe'l:
  He DIED in 1963.        ✓
  He WAS DIED in 1963.    ✗ XATO
  So'roqda: 'When DID he DIE?' — 'did' + asosiy shakl.

DIQQAT — YIL OLDIDAN 'IN':
  in 1917, in 1963 — yil oldidan DOIM IN.

DIQQAT — KASB OLDIDAN ARTIKL:
  He was AN American president.  (bir nechtadan biri → A/AN)
  She was THE Queen of England.  (o'sha davrda YAGONA → THE)
  She was THE Princess of Wales. (yagona unvon → THE)

exercises.instructionEn: Explain the verbs in the list.

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N TO'RT FE'L — HAMMASI O'TGAN ZAMONDA:
  died, divorced, watched, studied, married, continued,
  returned, loved, said, worked, cared, completed,
  called, appeared

Bu fe'llar 71-betdagi Diananing tarjimai holidagi
bo'shliqlarga qo'yiladi.

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — ODDIY O'TGAN ZAMON:
  Ko'pchilik fe'lga -ED qo'shiladi:
     work → worked;  love → loved;  study → studied

  -ED QO'ShIShNING UCH QOIDASI:
     1) oddiy holat        → + ED    (work → worked)
     2) oxirida -E bo'lsa  → + D     (love → loved,
                                      divorce → divorced)
     3) undosh + Y bo'lsa  → Y→I+ED  (study → studied)

  ISTISNO — NOTO'G'RI FE'L:
     say → SAID  (-ed QO'ShILMAYDI!)
     Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA noto'g'ri fe'l.

-ED NING UCH XIL O'QILISHI:
  /t/  — jarangsiz tovushdan keyin: worked, watched
  /d/  — jarangli tovushdan keyin: loved, called, appeared
  /ɪd/ — 't' yoki 'd' dan keyin: completed, divorced?
         (aniq: wanted /ˈwɒntɪd/, needed /ˈniːdɪd/)

exercises.instructionEn: A Fairy-Tale Princess — read the article.
exercises.instructionUz: Ertakdagidek malika — maqolani o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A FAIRY-TALE PRINCESS

  It was like a fairy tale when the beautiful young girl
  married the Prince and became the Princess of Wales.
  Unlike a fairy tale, the happiness soon ended, but Diana
  was still The People's Princess.

  1) Diana Frances Spencer was born on 1st July, 1961, in
     Norfolk, England. Her father was Earl Spencer. She had
     two older sisters and a younger brother. Her parents
     DIVORCED when she was a young girl. As a child, Diana
     STUDIED at a boarding school in Kent. She COMPLETED
     her education in Switzerland. When she RETURNED to
     England she WORKED as a nanny in London.

  2) Diana MARRIED Prince Charles in July, 1981, at St
     Paul's Cathedral in London. People all around the world
     WATCHED her wedding on television. Charles and Diana
     had two sons, William and Harry.

  3) Diana was very popular. The British LOVED her for her
     kindness and beauty. They CALLED her "The People's
     Princess" because she CARED so much about sick and poor
     people all over the world. She once SAID, "I see myself
     as a princess for the world, not the Princess of
     Wales." Reporters were always around her. She was their
     favourite person.

  4) But Diana's life wasn't as happy as it APPEARED. She
     and Charles had problems with their marriage. They
     finally divorced in August, 1996.

  5) Diana CONTINUED to travel round the world and help
     those in need. But her life was short — she DIED in a
     car accident on 31st August, 1997, in Paris. She was
     only thirty-six years old.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:

  ERTAKDAGIDEK MALIKA

  Go'zal yosh qiz shahzodaga turmushga chiqib, Uels
  malikasi bo'lganida bu xuddi ertakdek edi. Lekin
  ertakdan farqli o'laroq, baxt tez orada tugadi —
  ammo Diana baribir Xalq Malikasi bo'lib qoldi.

  1) Diana Frensis Spenser 1961-yil 1-iyulda Angliyaning
     Norfolk shahrida tug'ilgan. Otasi Erl Spenser edi.
     Uning ikkita katta opasi va bitta kichik ukasi bor
     edi. U yosh qiz bo'lganida ota-onasi ajrashdi. Bolalik
     chog'ida Diana Kentdagi internat maktabida o'qidi.
     Ta'limini Shveytsariyada tugatdi. Angliyaga qaytgach,
     Londonda enaga bo'lib ishladi.

  2) Diana 1981-yil iyulda Londondagi Avliyo Pavel
     soborida shahzoda Charlzga turmushga chiqdi. Butun
     dunyo odamlari uning to'yini televizorda tomosha
     qilishdi. Charlz va Diananing ikkita o'g'li bor edi —
     Uilyam va Garri.

  3) Diana juda mashhur edi. Britaniyaliklar uni
     mehribonligi va go'zalligi uchun sevishardi. Ular uni
     "Xalq Malikasi" deb atashdi, chunki u butun dunyodagi
     kasal va kambag'al odamlar haqida juda qayg'urardi.
     U bir marta shunday degan edi: "Men o'zimni Uels
     malikasi emas, balki butun dunyo uchun malika deb
     bilaman." Jurnalistlar doim uning atrofida edi.
     U ularning sevimli shaxsi edi.

  4) Lekin Diananing hayoti ko'ringanchalik baxtli emas edi.
     U va Charlz nikohlarida muammolarga duch kelishdi.
     Ular nihoyat 1996-yil avgustda ajrashdilar.

  5) Diana dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishni va muhtojlarga
     yordam berishni davom ettirdi. Lekin uning umri qisqa
     bo'ldi — u 1997-yil 31-avgustda Parijda avtohalokatda
     halok bo'ldi. U atigi o'ttiz olti yoshda edi.


MATN TUZILISHI (5 xatboshi):
  1  Bolalik va ta'lim
  2  To'y va farzandlar
  3  Mashhurligi va xalq mehri
  4  Nikohdagi muammolar va ajralish
  5  Fojiali oxir

UNIT MAVZUSI BILAN BOG'LIQLIGI:
  'The Price of Fame' — shuhratning narxi.
  Diana mashhur edi, lekin jurnalistlar doim atrofida edi
  va shaxsiy hayoti buzildi. Shuhratning 'narxi' shu.

tasks.note:
70-betdagi 3-mashqning 3-bandi shu gapdan olingan (T).
'the British' — millat nomi oldidan THE.

tasks.en: They called her "The People's Princess" because she cared so much about sick and poor people.
tasks.uz: Ular uni "Xalq Malikasi" deb atashdi, chunki u kasal va kambag'al odamlar haqida juda qayg'urardi.

'care ABOUT' = qayg'urmoq, befarq bo'lmaslik.
'The People'S' — apostrof egalik bildiradi.

tasks.en: Reporters were always around her. She was their favourite person.
tasks.uz: Jurnalistlar doim uning atrofida edi. U ularning sevimli shaxsi edi.

'a reporter' = jurnalist, muxbir.
SHUHRATNING NARXI shu — tinchlik yo'q.

tasks.en: But Diana's life wasn't as happy as it appeared.
tasks.uz: Lekin Diananing hayoti ko'ringanchalik baxtli emas edi.
tasks.note:
'AS happy AS' — tenglik darajasi.
'to appear' = ko'rinmoq (bu yerda 'aslida undoq emas' ma'nosida).

tasks.en: They finally divorced in August, 1996.
tasks.note:

tasks.en: Diana continued to travel round the world and help those in need.

'those in need' = muhtojlar.

tasks.en: She died in a car accident on 31st August, 1997, in Paris. She was only thirty-six years old.

70-betdagi 3-mashqning 4-bandi shu gapga asoslanadi:
'a train accident' XATO — A CAR ACCIDENT.
'die IN an accident' — predlog IN.

exercises.instructionEn: Read Diana's biography and fill in the gaps with the correct verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Diananing tarjimai holini o'qing va bo'shliqlarni to'g'ri fe'llar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (70-betdan, 14 ta fe'l):
  died, divorced, watched, studied, married, continued,
  returned, loved, said, worked, cared, completed,
  called, appeared

14 fe'l, 14 bo'shliq — har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA.
Bu tekshirish uchun yaxshi belgi.

USUL: har bir bo'shliq atrofidagi so'zlarga qarang.
  ... at a boarding school → o'qish → studied
  ... as a nanny          → ishlash → worked
  ... in a car accident    → o'lim  → died

HAMMA FE'L O'TGAN ZAMONDA (-ed),
chunki matn tarixiy voqealar haqida.

tasks.prompt: 1  Her parents ............ when she was a young girl.
tasks.whyUz:
'Her parents DIVORCED' = ota-onasi ajrashdi.
DIQQAT: 'divorce' bu yerda 'ajrashmoq' — to'ldiruvchi kerak emas.
4-xatboshida yana chiqadi: 'They finally divorced in 1996'.
tasks.speak: 1  Her parents ............ when she was a young girl.

tasks.prompt: 2  As a child, Diana ............ at a boarding school in Kent.
tasks.whyUz:
'STUDIED at a school' = maktabda o'qidi.
study → studied (undosh + Y → I + ED).
'a boarding school' = internat maktab.
tasks.speak: 2  As a child, Diana ............ at a boarding school in Kent.

tasks.whyUz:
'COMPLETED her education' = ta'limini tugatdi.
'complete' = tugatmoq, yakunlamoq.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').

'RETURNED to England' = Angliyaga qaytdi.
'return TO a place' — 'to' shart.
Shveytsariyadan qaytgan.

tasks.prompt: 5  ... she ............ as a nanny in London.
tasks.whyUz:
'WORKED as a nanny' = enaga bo'lib ishladi.
'work AS' — 'as' shart.
'a nanny' = enaga.
70-betdagi 3-mashqning 2-bandi shu gapga asoslanadi.
tasks.speak: 5  ... she ............ as a nanny in London.

tasks.whyUz:
'MARRIED Prince Charles' = shahzoda Charlzga turmushga chiqdi.
marry → married (undosh + Y → I + ED).
DIQQAT: 'married WITH Charles' XATO — 'with' KERAK EMAS.

tasks.prompt: 7  People all around the world ............ her wedding on television.
tasks.whyUz:
'WATCHED her wedding' = to'yini tomosha qilishdi.
'watch' — televizor va tomoshalar uchun
('see' emas, WATCH).
-ed /t/ deb o'qiladi.
tasks.speak: 7  People all around the world ............ her wedding on television.

tasks.prompt: 8  The British ............ her for her kindness and beauty.
tasks.whyUz:
'LOVED her' = uni sevishardi.
'love somebody FOR something' = biror fazilati uchun sevmoq.
70-betdagi 3-mashqning 3-bandi (T) shu gapdan.
tasks.speak: 8  The British ............ her for her kindness and beauty.

tasks.whyUz:
'CALLED her ...' = uni ... deb atashdi.
'call somebody + nom' — orada predlog YO'Q:
  They called her The People's Princess.  ✓
  They called her AS ...                  ✗ XATO

tasks.prompt: 10  ... because she ............ so much about sick and poor people.
tasks.whyUz:
'CARED about ...' = ... haqida qayg'urardi.
'care ABOUT' = befarq bo'lmaslik.
'care FOR' = parvarish qilmoq (biroz boshqa ma'no).
'so much' = juda ko'p.
tasks.speak: 10  ... because she ............ so much about sick and poor people.

tasks.prompt: 11  She once ............ , "I see myself as a princess for the world ..."
tasks.whyUz:
'SAID' = dedi.
Qo'shtirnoq ochilsa — gapirish fe'li kerak.
DIQQAT: 'say' — NOTO'G'RI fe'l:
  say → SAID  (-ed QO'ShILMAYDI)
Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA noto'g'ri fe'l.
'once' bu yerda = bir marta.
tasks.speak: 11  She once ............ , "I see myself as a princess for the world ..."

tasks.prompt: 12  But Diana's life wasn't as happy as it ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
'as happy as it APPEARED' = ko'ringanchalik baxtli.
'to appear' = ko'rinmoq, tuyulmoq.
Ma'nosi: tashqaridan baxtli ko'rinardi, aslida emas —
SHUHRATNING NARXI.
tasks.speak: 12  But Diana's life wasn't as happy as it ............ .

tasks.prompt: 13  Diana ............ to travel round the world and help those in need.
tasks.whyUz:
'CONTINUED to travel' = sayohat qilishni davom ettirdi.
'continue TO + fe'l' qolipi.
'those in need' = muhtojlar.
tasks.speak: 13  Diana ............ to travel round the world and help those in need.

tasks.prompt: 14  She ............ in a car accident on 31st August, 1997, in Paris.
tasks.whyUz:
'DIED in a car accident' = avtohalokatda halok bo'ldi.
die → died (-e ga faqat -D).
70-betdagi 3-mashqning 4-bandi (F) shu gapga asoslanadi:
poyezd emas, MAShINA halokati.
tasks.speak: 14  She ............ in a car accident on 31st August, 1997, in Paris.

tasks.en: Explain the words in bold in the text.
education

Fe'li: 'to educate' = ta'lim bermoq.

Boshqa oilaning bolalariga qaraydigan ayol.
DIQQAT: 'a nurse' (hamshira) BILAN ADAShTIRMANG —
70-betdagi 3-mashqda shu farq tekshiriladi.

tasks.en: a Prince
tasks.note:
'She married PRINCE Charles.'
Qirol yoki qirolichaning o'g'li.
Ayol jinsi: 'a Princess' = malika.

tasks.en: a wedding

Turmush qurish MAROSIMI (bir kunlik voqea).
DIQQAT: 'a marriage' — NIKOH (uzoq davom etadigan holat).

tasks.en: kindness

Sifat: 'kind' = mehribon.

tasks.en: a Princess

'They called her The People's PRINCESS.'
Shahzodaning xotini yoki qirolning qizi.
-ESS qo'shimchasi ayol jinsini bildiradi:

tasks.en: sick

= 'ill' bilan bir xil ma'no.

Aksi: 'rich' = boy.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, answer the questions below.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng quyidagi savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir savolning javobi matnda BOR.
To'liq gap bilan javob bering.

SAVOL SO'ZLARI:
  When ...?     → vaqt
  Where ...?    → joy
  How many ...? → son
  Why ...?      → sabab (javob 'Because ...')
  Was ...?      → ha/yo'q (qisqa javob + tushuntirish)

tasks.prompt: 1  When and where was Diana born?
tasks.answer: She was born on 1st July, 1961, in Norfolk, England.
tasks.whyUz:
IKKI savol birga: WHEN (vaqt) + WHERE (joy).
'was born ON + sana' — aniq sana bilan ON.
'IN Norfolk, England' — joy bilan IN.
tasks.speak: 1  When and where was Diana born?

tasks.answer: She studied at a boarding school in Kent and completed her education in Switzerland.
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda IKKI joy bor:
'a boarding school in Kent' va 'Switzerland'.
Ikkalasini ham aytish kerak — biri qoldirilsa javob to'liq emas.
'study AT a school' — predlog AT.

tasks.prompt: 3  When and where did she marry Prince Charles?
tasks.answer: She married him in July, 1981, at St Paul's Cathedral in London.
tasks.whyUz:
'IN July, 1981' — oy va yil bilan IN.
'AT St Paul's Cathedral' — aniq bino bilan AT.
Savolda 'did ... marry' (asosiy shakl),
javobda 'married' (o'tgan shakl).
tasks.speak: 3  When and where did she marry Prince Charles?

tasks.prompt: 4  How many children did they have?
tasks.answer: They had two sons, William and Harry.
tasks.whyUz:
'How many ...?' — SANALADIGAN ot bilan.
Javob: ikkita o'g'il — Uilyam va Garri.
Savolda 'did ... have', javobda 'had'.
tasks.speak: 4  How many children did they have?

tasks.answer: Because the British loved her for her kindness and beauty, and because she cared so much about sick and poor people all over the world.
tasks.whyUz:
'Why ...?' savoliga 'BECAUSE ...' bilan javob beriladi.
IKKI sabab bor: mehribonligi/go'zalligi va
kasal-kambag'allarga qayg'urishi.

tasks.prompt: 6  Was her life as happy as it appeared?
tasks.answer: No, it wasn't. She and Charles had problems with their marriage.
tasks.whyUz:
'Was ...?' savoliga qisqa javob: 'No, it wasn't.'
So'ng sabab tushuntiriladi.
'as happy as' — tenglik darajasi.
Bu — unitning asosiy g'oyasi: shuhrat baxt keltirmaydi.
tasks.speak: 6  Was her life as happy as it appeared?

tasks.whyUz:
'IN August, 1996' — oy va yil bilan IN.
Savolda 'did ... divorce', javobda 'divorced'.

tasks.prompt: 8  When and where did she die?
tasks.answer: She died on 31st August, 1997, in a car accident in Paris.
tasks.whyUz:
'ON 31st August, 1997' — aniq sana bilan ON.
'IN Paris' — shahar bilan IN.
'IN a car accident' — halokat bilan IN.
tasks.speak: 8  When and where did she die?

exercises.instructionEn: In the Public Eye — read the article about the Backstreet Boys.
exercises.instructionUz: Xalq nazarida — Backstreet Boys haqidagi maqolani o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHA: 'In the Public Eye'
  = xalq nazarida, hammaning ko'z o'ngida.
  Mashhur odamlar haqida ishlatiladigan ibora.

TO'LIQ MATN:

  They are young, talented and famous. They are the
  Backstreet Boys, or BSB FOR SHORT, an ALL-BOY BAND from
  America.

  The band started with Howie Dorough, AJ McLean and Nick
  Carter.

  AJ worked as a model when he was six. He also acted in
  school PLAYS. When he was fourteen, he got to know Howie.
  Howie had ROLES in films and plays. They became friends
  and went to AUDITIONS together. They met Nick at one of
  those auditions. Nick's parents had a disco and Nick used
  to dance there. The three of them started singing
  together for a RECORD COMPANY called Transcontinental
  Records.

  The record company OWNER, Lou Perlman, had a friend who
  knew Kevin Richardson. Kevin had a job at Disney World in
  Orlando at the time. When Lou's friend told Kevin about
  the new group, Kevin decided to meet them. The four
  became friends and Kevin JOINED THE GROUP. Lou wanted one
  more person for the group. The fifth member was Brian
  Littrell, Kevin's cousin.

  BSB released their first album in 1996. They received
  their first GOLD RECORD in Germany for this album. A
  second album followed in late 1997.

  BSB have got FANS in many countries. Do you want to write
  to them? Their address is: Backstreet Boys, Post Office
  Box 618203, Orlando, FL 32861-8203.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:

  Ular yosh, iqtidorli va mashhur. Ular — Backstreet Boys,
  qisqacha BSB, Amerikadan kelgan faqat o'g'il bolalardan
  iborat guruh.

  Guruh Xaui Doro, EY-Jey Maklin va Nik Karter bilan
  boshlangan.

  EY-Jey olti yoshida model bo'lib ishlagan. Shuningdek
  maktab spektakllarida rol o'ynagan. O'n to'rt yoshida
  Xaui bilan tanishgan. Xaui film va spektakllarda rollar
  o'ynagan edi. Ular do'stlashib, birga tinglovlarga
  borishgan. Nikni ana shu tinglovlarning birida
  uchratishgan. Nikning ota-onasining diskotekasi bor edi
  va Nik u yerda raqsga tushardi. Uchovi birgalikda
  Transcontinental Records nomli yozuv kompaniyasi uchun
  qo'shiq ayta boshladi.

  Yozuv kompaniyasining egasi Lu Perlmanning Kevin
  Richardsonni taniydigan do'sti bor edi. O'sha paytda
  Kevin Orlandodagi Disney Worldda ishlardi. Luning do'sti
  Kevinga yangi guruh haqida aytganda, Kevin ular bilan
  uchrashishga qaror qildi. To'rtovi do'stlashdi va Kevin
  guruhga qo'shildi. Lu guruhga yana bitta odam xohlardi.
  Beshinchi a'zo Kevinning amakivachchasi Brayan Littrell
  bo'ldi.

  BSB birinchi albomini 1996-yilda chiqardi. Shu albom
  uchun Germaniyada birinchi oltin plastinkasini oldi.
  Ikkinchi albom 1997-yil oxirida chiqdi.

  BSB ning ko'p mamlakatlarda muxlislari bor. Ularga xat
  yozmoqchimisiz? Manzillari: Backstreet Boys, Post Office
  Box 618203, Orlando, FL 32861-8203.


BESH A'ZO VA ULAR QANDAY QO'ShILGAN:
  1-3) Howie, AJ, Nick — guruhni BOSHLAGANLAR
  4)   Kevin Richardson — Lu ning do'sti orqali qo'shilgan
  5)   Brian Littrell — Kevinning AMAKIVACHCHASI

UNIT MAVZUSI BILAN BOG'LIQLIGI:
  Diana va Motsart kabi, BSB ham 'in the public eye' —
  xalq nazarida. Lekin bu yerda shuhratning YAXShI tomoni
  ko'rsatilgan: yosh, iqtidorli, muvaffaqiyatli.

            YOKI
            August the twenty-sixth, nineteen fifty-nine

IKKI XIL AYTISH USULI:

  1-USUL:  THE + tartib son + OF + oy + yil
           the twenty-sixth of August, nineteen fifty-nine

           August the twenty-sixth, nineteen fifty-nine

  1st  = the first        2nd  = the second
  3rd  = the third        4th  = the fourth

  13th = the thirteenth   16th = the sixteenth
  21st = the twenty-first 25th = the twenty-fifth
  29th = the twenty-ninth 31st = the thirty-first

  Yil IKKI JUFTGA bo'linadi:
     1959 → 19 | 59 → nineteen fifty-nine
     1935 → 19 | 35 → nineteen thirty-five
     1825 → 18 | 25 → eighteen twenty-five
     1899 → 18 | 99 → eighteen ninety-nine

  ISTISNO — oxiri '00' bo'lsa:
     1900 → nineteen hundred
     1980 → nineteen eighty  ('nineteen eight-oh' EMAS)
     2000 → two thousand
     2010 → two thousand and ten / twenty ten

DIQQAT — BRITAN va AMERIKA YOZILISHI FARQ QILADI:
  Britancha:  26/8/1959  (kun/oy/yil)
  Amerikacha: 8/26/1959  (oy/kun/yil)

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table, then say how we form the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang, so'ng oddiy o'tgan zamon qanday yasalishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE FORM (jadval):

  TASDIQ       I/you/he, etc  WATCHED TV last night.
  INKOR        I/you/he, etc  DIDN'T WATCH TV last night.
  SO'ROQ       DID I/you/he, etc  WATCH TV last night?
  QISQA JAVOB  Yes, I/you/he, etc DID.
               No,  I/you/he, etc DIDN'T.

QANDAY YASALADI:

  TASDIQ:  fe'l + -ED  (yoki noto'g'ri fe'l shakli)
           watch → watched;  make → made
           HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL — -s YO'Q!

  INKOR:   DIDN'T + fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
           I didn't WATCH   ✓
           I didn't WATCHED ✗ XATO

  SO'ROQ:  DID + ega + fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
           Did you WATCH?   ✓
           Did you WATCHED? ✗ XATO

  QISQA JAVOB: did / didn't (asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI)
           Yes, I did.      ✓
           Yes, I watched.  ✗

ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  'DID' yoki 'DIDN'T' bor bo'lsa — fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.
  Sababi: 'did' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatgan.
  Bu — 9-unitdagi 'didn't have' qoidasining o'zi.

USE (ishlatilishi):
  Past simple ni O'TMISHDA sodir bo'lgan va QAYTA
  TAKRORLANMAYDIGAN harakatlar uchun ishlatamiz.
     Diana MARRIED Prince Charles in July, 1981.
     (When did she marry him? In July, 1981.)

  VAQT IBORALARI (past simple belgilari):
     yesterday       = kecha
     ... ago         = ...oldin
     in 1950         = 1950-yilda
     last Monday     = o'tgan dushanba
     last week/month = o'tgan hafta/oy

WAS/WERE BILAN SOLISHTIRING (9-unit):
  'to be'  → did KERAK EMAS:  Were you at home?
  boshqa fe'l → did KERAK:    Did you watch TV?

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Marie Sklodowska (Marie Curie) was a famous scientist.
  She was born in 1867 in Warsaw, Poland. She studied
  physics and mathematics at the Sorbonne in Paris. She
  married Pièrre Curie in 1895. Together they discovered
  polonium and radium in 1898. In 1903, the Curies received
  the Nobel Prize for Physics. Pièrre died in a road
  accident in 1906. Marie continued their work on radium.
  In 1911, she received the Nobel Prize for Chemistry.
  She died of leukaemia in 1934.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Mariya Sklodovska (Mari Kyuri) mashhur olima edi.
  U 1867-yilda Polshaning Varshava shahrida tug'ilgan.
  U Parijdagi Sorbonnada fizika va matematika o'qidi.
  1895-yilda Pyer Kyuriga turmushga chiqdi. Ular birgalikda
  1898-yilda poloniy va radiyni kashf etishdi. 1903-yilda
  Kyurilar fizika bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini olishdi.
  Pyer 1906-yilda yo'l-transport hodisasida halok bo'ldi.
  Mariya radiy ustidagi ishlarini davom ettirdi. 1911-yilda
  u kimyo bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini oldi. U 1934-yilda
  leykemiyadan vafot etdi.

                 ('Polish scientist 1867 - 1934').
  Qolgan yillar — tarixiy faktlar.
  Kitobning o'zida bu javoblar YO'Q — o'qituvchi aytadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Spelling rules for the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Oddiy o'tgan zamonning yozilish qoidalari.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI TO'RT QOIDA:

  1) Ko'pchilik TO'G'RI fe'lga -ED qo'shamiz.
        I work  →  I worked

  2) Oxiri -E bilan tugagan fe'lga faqat -D qo'shamiz.
        I love  →  I loved

  3) UNDOSH + Y bilan tugagan fe'lda -Y tushadi,
     o'rniga -IED qo'shiladi.
        I study  →  I studied

  4) Boshqa fe'llarning NOTO'G'RI shakli bor.
        become  →  became
        say     →  said
     Kitobning OXIRIDAGI noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxatiga qarang.

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT — 3-QOIDA FAQAT UNDOSH + Y UCHUN:

  UNDOSH + Y  →  Y tushadi, -IED
     stUDy   → studied   (d — undosh)
     marRY   → married   (r — undosh)
     carRY   → carried
     buRY    → buried
     tRY     → tried

  UNLI + Y   →  Y QOLADI, faqat -ED
     enjOY   → enjoyed   (o — unli)
     plAY    → played    (a — unli)
     stAY    → stayed

  12-mashqdagi 'BUT enjoy' shu farqni ko'rsatish uchun.

QO'ShIMCHA QOIDA (kitobda yo'q, lekin foydali):
  Bir bo'g'inli, oxiri UNDOSH+UNLI+UNDOSH bo'lgan fe'lda
  oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI:
     stop → stopped;  plan → planned;  travel → travelled

tasks.en: Spelling rules for the past simple.

tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 3-QOIDA.
FAQAT UNDOSH + Y uchun.
marry → married;  bury → buried;  carry → carried.

tasks.en: Other verbs have irregular forms: become - became, say - said.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 4-QOIDA.
Ularni YODLASH kerak — qoida yo'q.

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Sir Alexander Fleming WAS a famous scientist. He was born
  in Scotland on 6th August, 1881. He STUDIED medicine at
  St Mary's Hospital in London. After World War I, he
  RETURNED to St Mary's and WORKED there as a professor.

  In 1915, he MARRIED Sarah Marion McElroy and they HAD a
  son. He DISCOVERED penicillin in 1928 and RECEIVED the
  Nobel Prize for Medicine in 1945. His wife DIED in 1949.
  Fleming married again in 1953. His second wife WAS a
  Greek doctor, Dr Amalia Koutsouris.

  Fleming DIED on 11th March, 1955. They BURIED him in
  St Paul's Cathedral.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Ser Aleksandr Fleming mashhur olim edi. U 1881-yil
  6-avgustda Shotlandiyada tug'ilgan. U Londondagi Avliyo
  Meri kasalxonasida tibbiyot o'qidi. Birinchi jahon
  urushidan keyin Avliyo Meriga qaytdi va u yerda professor
  bo'lib ishladi.
  1915-yilda Sara Marion Makelroyga uylandi va ularning
  o'g'li bo'ldi. U 1928-yilda penitsillinni kashf etdi va
  1945-yilda tibbiyot bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini oldi.
  Xotini 1949-yilda vafot etdi. Fleming 1953-yilda qayta
  uylandi. Ikkinchi xotini yunon shifokori — doktor Amaliya
  Kutsuris edi.
  Fleming 1955-yil 11-martda vafot etdi. Uni Avliyo Pavel
  soborida dafn etishdi.

SAVOLGA JAVOB — QAYSI FE'LLAR NOTO'G'RI?
  BE   → WAS  (1 va 10-bandlar)
  HAVE → HAD  (6-band)
  Qolgan hammasi TO'G'RI fe'l (-ed oladi).

DIQQAT — 'BURY' YOZILISHI:
  bury → BURIED  ('r' undosh + 'y' → -IED).
  O'qilishi /ˈberi/ — 'beri' kabi ('byuri' EMAS).

DIQQAT — DIANA BILAN BOG'LIQLIK:
  Fleming ham 'St Paul's Cathedral' da —
  Diana ham o'sha soborda turmush qurgan (71-bet).

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  medicine       = tibbiyot; dori
  a professor    = professor
  World War I    = Birinchi jahon urushi

  to bury        = dafn etmoq
  Greek          = yunon

SAVOL QOLIPI:
  WHEN WAS THE LAST TIME YOU ...?
  = Oxirgi marta qachon ...?

SAKKIZ KO'RSATMA:
  write a letter?          xat yozmoq
  visit your grandparents? bobo-buvingizni ko'rgani bormoq

  have a party?            ziyofat qilmoq

VAQT IBORALARI:
  yesterday                       kecha
  yesterday morning/evening, etc  kecha ertalab/kechqurun
  two days/weeks, etc ago         ikki kun/hafta oldin
  last Monday/Tuesday, etc        o'tgan dushanba/seshanba
  a week/month, etc ago           bir hafta/oy oldin

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: When was the last time you wrote a letter?
  SB: The last time I wrote a letter was two days ago.
      How about you?
  SA: The last time I wrote a letter was a month ago.

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT — SAVOLDA VA JAVOBDA IKKALASIDA HAM
O'TGAN SHAKL:
  When was the last time you WROTE a letter?   ✓
  When was the last time you WRITE a letter?   ✗ XATO

  Sababi: bu yerda 'did' YO'Q — 'was' bor.
  Shuning uchun asosiy fe'l O'TGAN shaklda qoladi.
  Bu — 17c-mashqdagi 'didn't + asosiy shakl' dan FARQ QILADI.

JAVOB QOLIPI:
  The last time I [o'tgan fe'l] ... WAS [vaqt].

DIQQAT — 'AGO' DOIM OXIRIDA:
  two days AGO;  a month AGO.
  'ago before' XATO.

DIQQAT — 'HOW ABOUT YOU?':
  = Sen-chi?  Savolni qaytarish uchun.
  'What about you?' ham to'g'ri.

exercises.instructionEn: Finally, write Mozart's biography.
exercises.instructionUz: Nihoyat, Motsartning tarjimai holini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ TARJIMAI HOL (A va B ustunlari qo'shilgan holda):

  Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart was born in Salzburg, Austria, in
  1756. He loved music and learnt to play the violin very
  well. He started writing music when he was five. He
  toured around western Europe with his father, Leopold,
  and played music for kings and queens. Everyone admired
  the talented young man and they often invited him to
  their balls. In 1781, he married Constanze Weber, but
  life was difficult because he had money problems. Mozart
  continued writing music and performing at the royal
  courts of Europe until he died in 1791. He was only 35
  years old.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Volfgang Amadey Motsart 1756-yilda Avstriyaning Zalsburg
  shahrida tug'ilgan. U musiqani sevardi va skripka
  chalishni juda yaxshi o'rgandi. Besh yoshida musiqa
  yozishni boshladi. Otasi Leopold bilan G'arbiy Yevropa
  bo'ylab gastrol qildi va qirol va qirolichalar uchun
  musiqa chaldi. Hamma iqtidorli yigitga qoyil qolardi va
  uni tez-tez o'z ballariga taklif qilishardi. 1781-yilda
  u Konstansa Veberga uylandi, lekin hayot og'ir edi,
  chunki moliyaviy muammolari bor edi. Motsart 1791-yilda
  vafot etgunicha musiqa yozishni va Yevropa saroylarida
  chiqish qilishni davom ettirdi. U atigi 35 yoshda edi.

UNIT MAVZUSI BILAN BOG'LIQLIGI:
  'The Price of Fame' — shuhratning narxi.
  Motsart butun Yevropada mashhur edi, qirollar uni
  taklif qilardi — lekin PULI YO'Q edi va 35 yoshda
  vafot etdi. Diana kabi, u ham shuhrat uchun 'narx' to'ladi.

DIQQAT — 'ONLY' JOYI:
  'He was ONLY 35 years old' = atigi 35 yoshda edi.
  'only' achinish ma'nosini beradi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Salzburg      = Zalsburg (Avstriya shahri)
  a violin      = skripka
  to tour       = gastrol qilmoq
  western Europe = G'arbiy Yevropa
  to admire     = qoyil qolmoq
  talented      = iqtidorli
  a ball        = bal, raqs kechasi
  money problems = moliyaviy muammolar
  to perform    = chiqish qilmoq
  the royal court = qirol saroyi

tasks.answer: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart was born in Salzburg, Austria, in 1756. He loved music and learnt to play the violin very well.
He started writing music when he was five.
He toured around western Europe with his father, Leopold, and played music for kings and queens.
Everyone admired the talented young man and they often invited him to their balls.
In 1781, he married Constanze Weber, but life was difficult because he had money problems.
Mozart continued writing music and performing at the royal courts of Europe until he died in 1791. He was only 35 years old.

sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'famous FOR' — 'for' SHART.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + fe'l+ED (yoki noto'g'ri shakl) + ... + vaqt iborasi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I watched TV last night. Diana married Prince Charles in July, 1981.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha kechqurun televizor ko'rdim. Diana 1981-yil iyulda shahzoda Charlzga turmushga chiqdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Tasdiq gapda fe'l O'TGAN shaklda.
Hamma ega uchun bir xil — -s yo'q.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + DIDN'T + ASOSIY fe'l.   /   DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I didn't cook dinner. Did you watch TV last night?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechki ovqat pishirmadim. Kecha kechqurun televizor ko'rdingmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'did/didn't' bor bo'lsa — fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.
Eng ko'p uchraydigan xato: 'didn't watched'.

sentencePatterns.formula: I + o'tgan fe'l + yesterday BUT I didn't + asosiy fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I made a cake yesterday but I didn't cook dinner.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha tort pishirdim, lekin kechki ovqat pishirmadim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bitta gapda IKKI xil shakl: 'made' (tasdiq) va 'cook' (inkor).

sentencePatterns.formula: X was born ON the [tartib son] OF [oy], [yil] and died ON ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Elvis Presley was born on the eighth of January, nineteen thirty-five and died on the sixteenth of August, nineteen seventy-seven.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Elvis Presli 1935-yil 8-yanvarda tug'ilgan va 1977-yil 16-avgustda vafot etgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 1-USUL: the + tartib son + OF + oy.

sentencePatterns.formula: X was born ON [oy] THE [tartib son], [yil].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Elvis Presley was born on January the eighth, nineteen thirty-five.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Elvis Presli 1935-yil 8-yanvarda tug'ilgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 2-USUL: oy + THE + tartib son.  'of' YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHEN/WHERE WAS he/she BORN?   ↔   WHEN DID he/she DIE?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When was she born? — In 1867. When did she die? — In 1934.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qachon tug'ilgan? — 1867-yilda. Qachon vafot etgan? — 1934-yilda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'be born' — 'did' KERAK EMAS ('to be' bilan).
'die' — 'did' KERAK (oddiy fe'l).

sentencePatterns.formula: die IN an accident   ↔   die OF an illness.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Pièrre died in a road accident. She died of leukaemia.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pyer yo'l-transport hodisasida halok bo'ldi. U leykemiyadan vafot etdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Halokat → IN;  kasallik → OF.
Bu farqni yodlab qo'yish kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + o'tgan zamon fe'li + ... + IN + yil.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He discovered penicillin in 1928 and received the Nobel Prize for Medicine in 1945.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U 1928-yilda penitsillinni kashf etdi va 1945-yilda tibbiyot bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini oldi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ikki harakat 'and' bilan bog'langan.
Yil oldidan IN.

sentencePatterns.formula: [rassom] PAINTED [asar].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Leonardo da Vinchi 'Mona Liza' ni chizgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
paint → painted (to'g'ri fe'l).
Majhul shakli: 'was painted by ...'.

sentencePatterns.formula: [bastakor] COMPOSED [asar].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mozart composed Requiem. Vivaldi composed The Four Seasons.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Motsart 'Rekviyem' ni bastalagan. Vivaldi 'To'rt fasl' ni bastalagan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: compose → composed (oxiri 'e' → faqat + D).

sentencePatterns.formula: He STARTED / CONTINUED + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He started writing music. Mozart continued writing music and performing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U musiqa yozishni boshladi. Motsart musiqa yozishni va chiqish qilishni davom ettirdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'start' va 'continue' dan keyin -ing shakli keladi
('to' + fe'l ham to'g'ri).

sentencePatterns.formula: ... , BUT life was difficult BECAUSE he had ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In 1781, he married Constanze Weber, but life was difficult because he had money problems.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 1781-yilda u Konstansa Veberga uylandi, lekin hayot og'ir edi, chunki moliyaviy muammolari bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'but' — qarama-qarshilik;  'because' — sabab.
Bitta gapda ikkalasi ham bo'lishi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: He CONTINUED ... UNTIL he DIED in [yil].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mozart continued writing music until he died in 1791.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Motsart 1791-yilda vafot etgunicha musiqa yozishni davom ettirdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'until' davom etgan harakatning OXIRINI ko'rsatadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: They BURIED him IN + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They buried him in St Paul's Cathedral.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uni Avliyo Pavel soborida dafn etishdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
bury → buried (undosh + Y → -IED).
'they' bu yerda aniq odamlar emas, umumiy ma'noda.

sentencePatterns.formula: WRONG! Ega + DIDN'T + ASOSIY fe'l + noto'g'ri ma'lumot. Ega + O'TGAN fe'l + to'g'ri ma'lumot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Wrong! AJ didn't work as a model when he was three. He worked as a model when he was six.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Noto'g'ri! EY-Jey uch yoshida model bo'lib ishlamagan. U olti yoshida model bo'lib ishlagan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bir javobda IKKI xil shakl:
inkorda ASOSIY, tasdiqda O'TGAN.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WASN'T + ... . It WAS ... .   ('be' fe'li uchun)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The fifth member wasn't Kevin. It was Brian Littrell.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Beshinchi a'zo Kevin emas edi. U Brayan Littrell edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'to be' fe'lida 'didn't' KERAK EMAS —
faqat 'wasn't/weren't'.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHEN WAS THE LAST TIME YOU + O'TGAN fe'l?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When was the last time you wrote a letter?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oxirgi marta qachon xat yozgan eding?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'did' YO'Q ('was' bor) → asosiy fe'l O'TGAN shaklda.
'you write' XATO — 'you WROTE'.

sentencePatterns.formula: The last time I + O'TGAN fe'l + ... WAS + vaqt ibora.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The last time I wrote a letter was two days ago.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oxirgi marta ikki kun oldin xat yozgandim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'ago' DOIM vaqt iborasining OXIRIDA.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + GOT TO KNOW + kim.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When he was fourteen, he got to know Howie.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'n to'rt yoshida Xaui bilan tanishdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'get to know somebody' = kimdir bilan tanishmoq.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + JOINED + guruh.   /   Ega + RELEASED + albom.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Kevin joined the group. BSB released their first album in 1996.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kevin guruhga qo'shildi. BSB birinchi albomini 1996-yilda chiqardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'join' dan keyin 'to' KERAK EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + USED TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Nick used to dance there.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nik u yerda raqsga tushardi (ilgari).
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: O'tmishdagi ODAT — endi takrorlanmaydi.
